Method of Attack: Malware loader that drops additional payloads such as remote access trojans, spyware, and ransomware
Callback phishing attack using social engineering to lure victims into calling a phone number and downloading malware
Remote access tool installed by support.Client.exe executable to take control of victim's device, including showing fake lock screen and stealing information
Impacted Systems: Users in United States, Canada, UK, India, China, Japan
Corporate networks accessed via infected devices
Attack Vector: Email campaigns pretending to be high-priced subscriptions with a phone number to call
Social engineering via phone calls leading to downloading malicious Excel files or executables
Malware masquerading as anti-virus software or refund portals
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with fake subscription invoices from Geek Squad, Norton, McAfee, PayPal, Microsoft
Phone numbers included in phishing emails
Malicious Excel files leading to BazarLoader installation
Websites used in BazarCall campaigns hosting malware
